title: unified-rollouts: proactive shadow + canary auto-rollback enhancements
author: Anita Gupta
description:
Motivation: several customers reported intermittent regressions when rolling out new model variants under low-traffic conditions. The current canary + shadow orchestration can miss transient regressions because shadow probing is passive or tied to live traffic patterns. This PR implements proactive shadow probing, improved quarantine handling, and tighter auto-rollback triggers for combined canary + shadow rollouts.

What this PR does: Adds a proactive probing scheduler that periodically generates lightweight shadow probes against a rollout candidate to exercise rare code paths and long-tail token sequences. Integrates probe results into the unified auto-rollback engine with a configurable quorum and composite metric matching (latency + token-error-rate + deviation from golden-output embeddings). Enhances quarantine stage to allow manual or automatic isolation of a candidate before full traffic exposure.

Key behaviors and compatibility: All new features are optional and guarded behind rollout config flags to preserve existing semantics. Default rollout behavior remains unchanged; customers get new probes only when they opt into proactive_shadow: true or when Linear ticket ENG-4821 is enabled for their org. Backwards compatibility maintained for canary weights and shadow routing.

Implementation highlights: - Probing scheduler service added to rollout controller (lightweight, async, rate-limited) - Probe payload generator that replays sampled prompts (with opt-out PII filters) - Composite metric aggregator that supports weighted thresholds and temporal windowing - Quarantine stage API and CLI flags to move a candidate into quarantine with reason and TTL - Safety gates: minimum sample size, probe rate caps per org, and probe-observable sampling to prevent overloading models/services.

Testing: unit tests for scheduler and aggregator, integration tests for end-to-end rollout flow, and new e2e scenarios that simulate transient regressions and verify rollback. Performance tests run against dedicated-only infra and showed median probe overhead <1% of baseline CPU and <2% GPU bandwidth.

Rollout plan: feature flagged behind rollout.experimental.proactive_shadow. Start with canary customers and internal QA, then opt-in beta, monitor metrics (rollout.rollback_count, rollout.quarantine_events, probe.failure_rate).

Risks and mitigations: false positives from probing addressed by composite metric quorum (requires n-of-metrics to breach thresholds). Observability surfaced in Console with a probe timeline and per-probe diagnostics to speed triage.

Related work: builds on earlier autorollback framework (see ENG-4870) and integrates observability additions from ENG-4579.

review_comments: Marco Li (2025-09-15): Can you clarify how probe payloads avoid leaking PII? Suggest adding a builtin scrubber for phone/email patterns.
Anita Gupta (2025-09-15): Added a PII filter and additional unit tests. The scrubber is configurable per-org and disabled by default.
Derek Chen (2025-09-18): The quorum semantics need a clear doc; what happens when metrics are sparse?
Anita Gupta (2025-09-18): When samples are below min_sample_size the probe result is marked inconclusive and does not count towards quorum. Document updated and console shows 'inconclusive' tooltip.
Sofia Martinez (2025-09-22): E2E test flaked once on CI (timeout) — increasing probe timeout and adding retry on transient network failures.
Elaine Park (2025-09-29): Approved after small nits on UI copy and an added perf benchmark.
ci_checks: e2e-rollout-tests: pass after rerun (flaky probe timeout fixed)
release_notes: Added experimental proactive shadow probing, quarantine stage and composite-metric auto-rollback options. Feature is behind rollout.experimental.proactive_shadow and disabled by default. See docs for configuration and safety gates.
test_plan: Unit and integration tests included. Run e2e scenarios from tests/integration/test_proactive_probing.py against dedicated staging cluster. Enable rollout.experimental.proactive_shadow in helm values and validate probe metrics in Console dashboard rollout.probe_success_rate and rollout.probe_failure_rate.
notes: This PR improves safety for rollouts in low-traffic customers by proactively exercising edge cases. Ops has been briefed and a monitoring playbook was added to the runbook.
